name: Climbing onto big creatures
author: Alexandria
summary: Characters can scramble onto a creature two sizes larger and fight from its back.

rules.term: Climbing onto a bigger creature (house rule)
rules.text: To climb onto a creature **at least two sizes larger**, make an **Athletics or Acrobatics check against its Acrobatics**. On a success you are on it and move with it; attacks against it have **advantage** from you. It can shake you off with its own check on its turn.

assistant.gm: Climbing onto big creatures is on: a character can climb a creature two sizes larger with Athletics or Acrobatics against its Acrobatics, then gains advantage on attacks against it until shaken off (its contest on its turn).
assistant.player: At this table you can try to climb onto a creature two sizes bigger (Athletics or Acrobatics against it) and attack with advantage from its back.
